text_simplified: Part of kindness toward a daughter is seeking a righteous husband who will help her upon goodness, as Abu Bakr, Umar, and others (may Allah be pleased with them) did, while avoiding extravagance and unlawful practices in wedding celebrations. Parents also fulfill their duty by keeping their daughter away from mixed gatherings and places of disobedience, and teaching her to go to markets only when necessary with full modesty and covering, in accordance with the statement of the Prophet ﷺ: "The most beloved of places to Allah are their mosques, and the most disliked of places to Allah are their markets" (Sahih Muslim 671).
